findings.evidence: Lines 80-82 declare `@[simp] theorem length_relators`; lines 113-116 prove the new statement as `P.length_relators.trans h`, adding no step beyond `Eq.trans`.
findings.fix: Delete `length_relators_eq_expected`; `length_relators` being `@[simp]` already discharges the goal from `matchesMetadata`'s second conjunct.
findings.issue: `length_relators_eq_expected` is the composite of the `@[simp]` lemma `length_relators` (line 81) with its own hypothesis `h`; its proof is literally `P.length_relators.trans h`. It has no consumer in the repo, and any consumer holding `h` closes the goal with `by simp [h]` or `P.length_relators.trans h`.

findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Data/Set/Finite/Basic.lean:405`: `theorem List.finite_toSet (l : List α) : { x | x ∈ l }.Finite`. The PR's own proof is `simpa only [relatorSet] using (P.relators.map FreeGroup.mk).finite_toSet`, i.e. the located lemma applied after unfolding the def.
findings.fix: Delete `relatorSet_finite`; a caller needing finiteness writes `(P.relators.map FreeGroup.mk).finite_toSet`, which closes `P.relatorSet.Finite` directly.
findings.issue: `relatorSet_finite` restates Mathlib's `List.finite_toSet` at the definitional level: `relatorSet` is defined as `{r | r ∈ P.relators.map FreeGroup.mk}` (line 86), which is syntactically the statement of `List.finite_toSet`. The lemma has no consumer in the PR.

summary: The record and its compilation to PresentedGroup are new material and reuse Mathlib (FreeGroup.mk, PresentedGroup, List.finite_toSet) correctly; nothing in Mathlib or TauCeti duplicates the metadata structure. Two of the five lemmas are restatements of material already present one line above them or in Mathlib.
